notes: Plant wind case P01_palm_tree (Ball-chain palm) written by scripts/build_plants.py: Palm 2518c01 taken apart: base 2563a, six 2536a ball-jointed trunk segments, top 2566b, four 2518 leaves. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: bend_1: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -40.0, 0.0] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2563a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); bend_2: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -73.81, 9.065] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2536a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); bend_3: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -108.565, 13.265] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2536a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); bend_4: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -143.565, 14.0] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2536a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); bend_5: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -178.32, 9.8] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2536a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); bend_6: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [0.0, -212.13, 0.735] (real: 2536a ball (y=+3) in the socket (y=-32) of 2536a; one of the ball's two tilt freedoms used, about Z so that the trunk bends with the wind); crown_twist: real revolute about [0.0, -0.906106, -0.42305] through [0.0, -232.968, -8.994] (real: 2566b spike (pin, local y 20..44) turning in the top 2536a; twist about the trunk axis); leaf_front: flex_approx revolute about [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] through [-10.0, -258.34, -20.832] (flex_approx: the leaf is held rigidly on two 2566b prongs; the tilt stands in for the long leaf bending. 2518 leaf root between its two prong holes; tilt about the leaf's own cross axis); leaf_upwind: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.42305, -0.906106] through [0.0, -255.316, -8.388] (flex_approx: the leaf is held rigidly on two 2566b prongs; the tilt stands in for the long leaf bending. 2518 leaf root between its two prong holes; tilt about the leaf's own cross axis); leaf_back: flex_approx revolute about [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0] through [10.0, -258.34, -20.832] (flex_approx: the leaf is held rigidly on two 2566b prongs; the tilt stands in for the long leaf bending. 2518 leaf root between its two prong holes; tilt about the leaf's own cross axis); leaf_downwind: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, -0.42305, 0.906106] through [0.0, -246.864, -26.514] (flex_approx: the leaf is held rigidly on two 2566b prongs; the tilt stands in for the long leaf bending. 2518 leaf root between its two prong holes; tilt about the leaf's own cross axis).

Real LEGO freedoms: bend_1, bend_2, bend_3, bend_4, bend_5, bend_6, crown_twist. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): leaf_front, leaf_upwind, leaf_back, leaf_downwind.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): bend_1 + = Trunk segment 1 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); bend_2 + = Trunk segment 2 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); bend_3 + = Trunk segment 3 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); bend_4 + = Trunk segment 4 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); bend_5 + = Trunk segment 5 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); bend_6 + = Trunk segment 6 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); crown_twist + = Crown on the top segment's spike (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z about the trunk; leaf_front + = Leaf front at its root (flex_approx); + lifts the tip; leaf_upwind + = Leaf upwind at its root (flex_approx); + lifts the tip; leaf_back + = Leaf back at its root (flex_approx); + lifts the tip; leaf_downwind + = Leaf downwind at its root (flex_approx); + lifts the tip.

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
